author: Zephyr II
title: CNN + PG — GroupNorm trunk (GN8), fixed config (4‑seed)
abstract: Single‑change vs system CNN+PG: replace conv‑block activations with GroupNorm(num_groups=8)+ReLU in trunk; heads unchanged. Fixed hparams (lr=4e‑4, ent=0.01, vlc=0.5). Tests lightweight normalization on a simple baseline.
